notes: Structured effects of Liz Sherman (F07 step 13, data only: the interpreter does not read them yet). Texts read from sheet 199 of the tournament save on 2026-10-28. Migrated to DSL v1 (docs/effects-dsl.md) on 2026-10-28 without changing the semantics.

Burning cards (tag burning) have no boost (BOOST 0). WILDFIRE returns them to the hand when they are discarded from the hand or the deck: before it was the liz:wildfire plugin; now it is the wildfire_return trigger (card_discarded event), which says exactly the same. Ivan's decision (28/10): the only exception is the discard for the hand limit at the end of the turn (cause hand_limit): that burning card stays in the discard. If the interpreter prefers a replacement of the discard's destination, it goes back to being a plugin without touching the cards.
Ivan's decision (28/10): 'bottom card of your deck' is the lowest card of the deck (the last), not the top one that is drawn. It is the one Wildfire uses at turn start and Flame Lash.
Ivan's decision (28/10): empty deck at turn start or with Flame Lash: nothing happens (no damage or movement; Flame Lash adds 0).
Ivan's decision (28/10): Wildfire's damage at turn start is mandatory if there is a target, and only to ONE fighter.
Ivan's decision (28/10): an effect that ignores the PRINTED VALUE does not remove Fight Or Flight's +1; one that ignores the VALUE does.
Ivan's decision (28/10): with the bot playing Liz, the bot turns the bottom of the deck at the start of its turn.
Ivan's decision (28/10): a card with no boost value cannot be used to boost: burning cards (BOOST 0) are never discarded as a boost.
Ivan's decision (28/10): a single active ONGOING PER PLAYER; playing another replaces the player's own active one (two Fight Or Flight = +1). Implemented in Game.add_combat_bonus.

ability.text:
WILDFIRE
Whenever you discard a burning card from your hand or deck, put it into your hand.
At start of your turn, discard the bottom card of your deck. If it's a burning card, deal 1 damage to another fighter in Liz's zone. Otherwise, move Liz up to 2 spaces.
ability.notes: With an empty deck at turn start nothing is discarded and nothing happens (no damage or movement): hence the exists condition on the deck (Ivan's decision, 28/10). The return to the hand is a rule over every discard of Liz's player: ability, Flame Lash, Fleeting Moments, rival effects that make Liz discard. Playing a card is not discarding it: burning cards that are played stay in the discard.

cards.title: Incinerate
cards.text: This card's effect cannot be canceled. DURING COMBAT: Your opponent may discard 2 cards to ignore this card's value.
cards.notes: 'This card's effects cannot be canceled': uncancelable attribute that cancel_effects respects. Ivan's decision (28/10): the rival may discard 2 cards from the hand, IN ADDITION to the card it defends with, to ignore Incinerate's value (it stays at 0); if it did not defend with a card, discarding 2 also works. With fewer than 2 cards in hand it cannot pay.

cards.title: Fireball
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to the defender.
cards.notes: Attack only: the defender is always a rival and is not adjacent to itself, so it does not take the immediate damage. Adjacent = a space connected to the defender's.

cards.title: Flame Lash
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: Discard the bottom card of your deck. Add its BOOST value to this card's value. AFTER COMBAT: Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: If the bottom card is burning, Wildfire returns it to the hand and it adds 0 (it has no boost). With an empty deck nothing is discarded, the binding stays empty and the attribute reads 0. The action is gained even if Liz loses the combat.

cards.title: Fleeting Moments
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: You and your opponent both discard 1 random card, then you both draw 1 card.
cards.notes: First both discard, then both draw. If Liz's random discard is burning, Wildfire returns it to the hand (and she still draws).

cards.title: Burning Barrier
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: The opposing fighter cannot leave their space this turn. AFTER COMBAT: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in Liz's zone.
cards.notes: Versatile: played in defense, 'this turn' is the attacker's turn. Ivan's decision (28/10): cannot_leave_space blocks all movement of the rival fighter (own or by effects); an effect can move Liz. The later damage is to each rival in Liz's zone.

cards.title: Pyrotechnics
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: You may put up to 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order.
cards.notes: It prepares the ability: a burning card at the bottom returns to the hand at turn start and deals 1 damage; a non-burning one gives the 2 movement. The cards go face down: the rival does not see them.

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Training
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. Move each friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.
cards.notes: Liz has no sidekicks: in practice it only moves Liz. Same card as in Hellboy (there it also moves Lobster).

cards.title: Rekindle
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.notes: After shuffling, any known order of the bottom of the deck (Pyrotechnics) is lost.

cards.title: Feint
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Searing Clarity
cards.text: Shuffle a non-scheme card from your discard pile into your deck. Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Shuffling is mandatory if there is a candidate (amount 1 without up_to; with no candidates it does nothing); the action is gained anyway: the scheme comes out free. It is burning: if discarded from the hand or the deck it returns; played, it goes to the discard without returning.

cards.title: Fight Or Flight
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Move Liz up to 5 spaces. She may move through opposing fighters. ONGOING: Add +1 to the value of your combat cards. Discard this at the start of your next turn.
cards.notes: The ONGOING is not in unmatched-memory; it comes from the real card. With Ivan's rule (28/10) of a single active ONGOING, a second copy replaces the first (+1); the engine still accumulates and has to be changed. It is discarded at the start of Liz's next turn, before Wildfire's bottom discard (assumed order; they do not interact because it is not burning).

hidden_info.where: ability / Flame Lash (bottom of the own deck)
hidden_info.rule: The bottom card is unknown to both until it is discarded; when discarded it is public. The bot with Liz does not look at the bottom before deciding on Flame Lash: it values with the remaining composition of the deck (unseen cards), except for what it put there itself with Pyrotechnics, which it remembers with its order (legitimate information). After Rekindle or Searing Clarity (shuffle) it forgets that order.

The bot never chooses the card: the human (or the bridge) draws it at random; if the bot has to choose for the rival, it chooses a uniform index without looking at identities. The discarded card is public: it is discounted from KnownHand if it had been seen. The rival's later draw is an unseen card (counts +1, KnownHand the same). Its own random discard is done with the RNG over its hand.

hidden_info.where: Incinerate (the rival discards 2 of their choice)
hidden_info.rule: The 2 discarded cards are public: the bot with Liz discounts them from KnownHand and learns nothing more. When the bot is the rival, it decides only with its own hand.

hidden_info.where: Wildfire (a burning card returns to the hand)
hidden_info.rule: The card returns to the hand in plain sight: it becomes part of the rival's KnownHand (when the human plays Liz, the bot notes it as seen and discounts it when it is played).

hidden_info.where: Pyrotechnics (cards from the hand to the bottom face down)
hidden_info.rule: The rival does not see them. When the human plays Liz, the bot does not read which ones they were: it only knows the hand goes down 2 and the deck up 2; the seen cards of KnownHand are not discounted (a seen one may or may not have gone) and the sampling of hidden hands respects only the count. When the bot plays Liz, it remembers its own order of the bottom.

hidden_info.where: Rekindle / Searing Clarity (from the discard to the deck)
hidden_info.rule: The chosen cards are public (they leave the discard in plain sight); the deck is shuffled: both know the composition, nobody the order.
Public: the card is shown when discarded; if it is burning, everyone sees that it returns to Liz's hand.

open_questions: Order at the start of Liz's turn: first Fight Or Flight is discarded and then Wildfire's bottom card. An assumption; they do not interact.
